resources.string: The key can be exported in a supported encrypted format. The destination must preserve its ID, key and registration properties; website compatibility still depends on the destination client.
The private key is bound to this device and cannot be exported. Copying the database alone will not enable sign-in on another device.
No usable private key was found on this device. This record alone cannot sign in here or on another device.
This credential was marked as not backup eligible. Only a destination that preserves that property can use it; conversion to Bitwarden or credential exchange is blocked.
This credential has a nonzero signature counter history. Monica uses zero counters; cross-device use may be rejected by a website that checks prior counters.
The destination must support the same key algorithm. Current Bitwarden transfer supports ES256 only.
The backup properties conflict. Signing must not silently change registered properties; keep the source credential for recovery.
Key capability could not be checked. Unlock the source database and try again.
